safety: Exactly 12 cookies exist; they are created in pipeline.py and nowhere else.
Every transfer is atomic - all locks taken at once, released at the end - so hold-and-wait cannot occur and a deadlock cannot form.
Locks are acquired in one fixed total order over resources.
A move never starts unless its destination has room, so a gripper never lifts a cookie with nowhere to put it down.
The oven is a single-part station: tray and chamber are excluded together, which is the deadlock the wait-for detector actually found.
Every pose the schedule commands is checked against the module geometry.

    I2     : BOOL;          (* reference turntable (belt position) *)
    I4     : BOOL;          (* reference turntable (saw position) *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Q1     : BOOL;          (* turntable clockwise (M1) *)
    Q2     : BOOL;          (* turntable counter-clockwise (M1) *)
    Q4     : BOOL;          (* saw (M3) *)
    Q14    : BOOL;          (*  *)
    Busy, Done, Fault : BOOL;
    Alarm  : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    Step, Prev : INT := 0;
    Wd : TON;               (* step watchdog *)
    Limit : TIME;
END_VAR

(* every scan: outputs off unless the active step sets them *)
Q1 := FALSE; Q2 := FALSE; Q4 := FALSE; Q14 := FALSE;
IF NOT Enable AND Step <> 900 THEN Step := 900; END_IF

Wd(IN := (Step = Prev), PT := Limit);
Prev := Step;
IF Wd.Q AND Limit > T#0MS THEN Alarm := Step; Step := 910; END_IF

CASE Step OF
  0: (* INIT: power-up: all outputs off *)
      Limit := T#0MS; IF Enable THEN Step := 10; END_IF
  10: (* H:push: Auswerfer home *)
      Limit := T#1400MS;
      IF I15 THEN Step := 11; END_IF
  11: (* H:turn: Drehtisch to the vacuum position *)
      Limit := T#2800MS; Q2 := TRUE;
      IF I1 THEN Done := TRUE; Step := 100; END_IF
  100: (* READY: homed, waiting for a job *)
      Limit := T#0MS; Busy := FALSE;
      IF Job = 1 THEN Busy := TRUE; Step := 1000; END_IF  (* saw_eject *)
  1000: (* saw_eject.01: Q1: Drehtisch to the Säge (I4) *)
      Limit := T#2800MS; Q1 := TRUE;
      IF I4 THEN Step := 1001; END_IF
  1001: (* saw_eject.02: Q4: saw runs *)
      Limit := T#0MS; Q4 := TRUE;
      IF Wd.ET >= T#2000MS THEN Step := 1002; END_IF
  1002: (* saw_eject.03: Drehtisch to the belt (I2) *)
      Limit := T#2800MS; Q1 := TRUE;
      IF I2 THEN Step := 1003; END_IF
  1003: (* saw_eject.04: Q14: Auswerfer pushes the workpiece onto the belt *)
      Limit := T#1400MS; Q14 := TRUE;
      IF I14 THEN Step := 1004; END_IF
  1004: (* saw_eject.05: Auswerfer home *)
      Limit := T#1400MS;
      IF I15 THEN Step := 1005; END_IF
  1005: (* saw_eject.06: I3 passed: Drehtisch home *)
      Limit := T#2800MS; Q2 := TRUE;
      IF I1 THEN Done := TRUE; Step := 100; END_IF
  910: (* FAULT: a step timed out: outputs off, alarm raised *)
      Limit := T#0MS; Fault := TRUE; IF Ack AND Enable THEN Fault := FALSE; Step := 900; END_IF
  900: (* ESTOP: safety relay dropped: outputs off (K1/K2 open) *)
      Limit := T#0MS; IF Reset AND Enable THEN Step := 0; END_IF
END_CASE

(* The orchestrator: one scan = the dispatcher of control.py, in the same priority order *)
PROGRAM MAIN
VAR
    Crane : FB_Crane; Belt : FB_Belt; Arm : FB_Arm; Door : FB_Door;
    Sauger : FB_Sauger; Turntable : FB_Turntable; Ovenbelt : FB_Ovenbelt; Line : FB_Line;
    Places : ST_Places;    (* slots, belt ends, nests, tray, turntable, belts, bays *)
    Records : ARRAY[0..11] OF ST_Cookie;
END_VAR

(* 1. finish: every unit that reports Done applies its job's effect to Places *)
(* 2. dispatch, highest priority first; a job starts only if all its units are READY *)
(*  1 sort          IF sort inlet has a cookie AND its bay has room *)
(*  2 ovenbelt      IF oven belt has a cookie AND sort inlet free *)
(*  3 saw_eject     IF turntable has a baked cookie AND oven belt free *)
(*  4 to_tt         IF tray has a baked cookie AND turntable free *)
(*  5 bake          IF tray has a raw cookie *)
(*  6 present       IF tray empty AND not presented AND a cookie is committed to it (on the cup or being picked) *)
(*  7 place_oven    IF a cookie on the cup AND the tray presented *)
(*  8 buf_to_oven   IF a nest holds a raw cookie AND no cookie committed to the tray AND the cup empty (FIFO) *)
(*  9 belt_to_oven  IF hand-over mould holds a raw cookie AND no cookie committed to the tray AND the cup empty AND buffer empty *)
(* 10 belt_to_buf   IF hand-over mould holds a raw cookie AND the oven cannot take it AND a nest is free *)
(* 11 bay_to_belt   IF hand-over mould is empty and earmarked AND a bay holds a cookie going in *)
(* 12 belt_back     IF hand-over mould goes in AND crane end free *)
(* 13 store_retrieve IF crane-end mould goes in AND hand-over free AND the order has a cookie in the rack: store into the free slot nearest it, retrieve it on the same trip *)
(* 14 belt_fwd      IF crane-end mould goes out AND hand-over free *)
(* 15 store         IF crane-end mould goes in AND a slot is free *)
(* 16 fetch_empty   IF belt empty AND a cookie still needs a mould AND nothing to retrieve *)
(* 17 retrieve      IF belt empty (BOTH ends) AND the order has a cookie in the rack *)

END_PROGRAM
